# archestra_agent_hook (Resource)

Versioned hook file executed for an agent event. Destroy removes the hook configuration; applying it does not execute the hook.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "archestra_agent_hook" "example" {
  agent_id  = archestra_agent.example.id
  event     = "pre_tool_use"
  file_name = "validate.py"
  content   = "print(\"validate tool input\")"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Agent id.
- `content` (String) Content.
- `event` (String) Event.
- `file_name` (String) File name.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled.
- `requirements` (List of String) Requirements.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Created at.
- `id` (String) Id.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization id.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import archestra_agent_hook.example hook_uuid:agent_uuid
```
